source: Used to unlock upgrades in the Capital between runs
translation: 用于在每局之间 解锁主城升级

source: Welcome to Combolands!@[LMB] To select and place buildings@[RMB] To cancel building placement
translation: 欢迎来到 Combolands！ @ [LMB] 选择并放置建筑 @ [RMB] 取消建筑放置

source: {Anything} on a {tile} is considered a {Building}, even things like [Trees] or [Flowers]
translation: {地块} 上的 {任何物体} 都算作 {建筑}， 即使是 [Trees] 或 [Flowers]

source: If a building on the map is {highlighted in blue}, it means the building you're currently placing {interacts} with it
translation: 地图上的建筑 若以 {蓝色高亮} 显示， 表示当前要放置的 建筑会与它 {互动}

source: More information about the current state of the map can be found in the overlays panel by pressing the button above
translation: 点击上方按钮， 打开信息图层， 可查看地图 当前状态的 更多信息

source: You can get more detail on buildings with @[LMB] and [RMB] @Extra information will always show up in the bottom right corner so it doesn't hide the map
translation: 使用 @ [LMB] 和 [RMB] @ 查看建筑详情。 详细信息始终 显示在右下角， 避免遮挡地图

source: Your run will save at the {start} of each milestone
translation: 每个里程碑 {开始} 时， 会自动保存 本局进度

source: [HousePlot] cares about being within [Range] of {existing} buildings on the map (blue highlights help here)
translation: 放置 [HousePlot] 时， 需考虑地图上 {已有} 建筑的 [Range] （蓝色高亮 可辅助判断）

source: Each building can {trigger} a maximum of 10 times per week (unless otherwise specified)
translation: 每座建筑每周 最多 {触发} 10 次 （另有说明除外）
